Definition: Obed, the name of five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Obed was the son of Boaz and Ruth, born in Bethlehem, and the father of Jesse and grandfather of David. The women of Bethlehem named him, saying, There is a son born to Naomi, and called his name Obed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Obed is the hinge of the whole story of redemption: the son of Ruth and Boaz, the father of Jesse, the grandfather of David, and the great-grandfather of the line that leads to Jesus.
RelatedPeople: Obed, Son of Boaz; Boaz; Ruth
